decisions.summary: Code fingerprint takes NAME=<value> for every in-scope constant the unit reads - own module, from x import NAME, or <alias>.NAME for an in-scope module alias - keyed by constant name so a split owes nothing
decisions.why: Round-1 item resolved: the alias route is now in D3 and in the draft (module_aliases, values()). The plan's words cover every in-scope constant read through a from-import. IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT against those words, measured 2026-10-02 (probe over claims._scope_trees): 22 from-imports name a constant through an in-scope module that only RE-EXPORTS it (e.g. hamletgen/plan reads GROVE_SIDES from hamletgen/consts, which imports it from settlement/homestead_parts/grove_sides); the draft values() looks NAME up only in the importing source module's own assignments, so those readers would not be owed when the value changes (SC-002), and the plan's own CC-file-scale split ('re-exported where callers import it') would drop callers' hits and change their cores. Resolve a from-import through re-export chains to the defining module, with a fixture test, before D3 is ticked.
